Question Choices: A whole is divided into 23 equal parts. What fraction is 12 parts?
Hints: Count selected equal parts over all equal parts.
Solution: Twelve selected equal parts out of 23 make 12/23.

Question Choices: Which expression means "divide by 4"? : A B C
Hints: A fraction bar means numerator divided by denominator. Dividing by a nonzero number multiplies by its reciprocal.
